items.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: I am very honored to come to L.A. and play with Bill Berry, and with great musicians all together.

ctx.x: I understand you come here every year, for quite a while.

Yes. This year is the ninth annual. It began in ’91 and then every year I come to Los Angeles for the International Jazz Party. I am very honored to come to L.A. and play with Bill Berry, and with great musicians all together.
Did you meet Bill in Japan years ago?
